name: @tumbaland/collage-core
description: What a collage is and how it is drawn, shared by the Tumbaland editor and server
author: Tumbaland

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/mark-esm.mjs
scripts.release: commit-and-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public && node ../../scripts/sync-lib-versions.mjs
scripts.release:beta: commit-and-tag-version --prerelease beta && npm run build && npm publish --access public --tag beta
